question.problem: Expressed as a fraction in lowest terms, $\frac{5}{2}÷(7+5)=${{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
To evaluate this expression, we use PEMDAS.

First, we perform the operation inside the parentheses:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{2}÷(7+5) & = \\ \frac{5}{2}÷12\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we divide:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5}{2}÷12 & = \\ \frac{5}{2}÷\frac{12}{1} & = \\ \frac{5}{2}\times \frac{1}{12} & = \\ \frac{5\times 1}{2\times 12} & = \\ \frac{5}{24}\end{aligned}
$$
